name: Paola
promptText: A full-body, front-facing depiction of a fit adult woman with an athletic build and average height, standing with arms crossed in a neutral stance. She has medium-light skin, bored, droopy eyes, and exceptionally voluminous 80s-style hair with a grey headband. She wears a crewneck sweatshirt with matching wrist cuffs and tight black athletic leggings. Over the leggings are bunched grey leg warmers and light grey high-top sneakers. The expression is neutral and unamused.
